rationale: The agent replaced the naive per-total rounding with the shared currency-aware roundMoney helper and, critically, replaced the hardcoded ±0.01 adjustment in reconcileTotal with the actual computed diff (roundMoney(total - linesSum, currency)), which fixes the underlying bug for any gap size rather than adding a new special case for the 0.02 scenario. Since roundMoney already encapsulates the JPY whole-yen/half-up rules and is now applied consistently, the FIN-88 behavior is preserved, not broken.
